# Third-party assets

All assets are bundled locally. No CDN calls are made by the game.

- **pdf-lib 1.17.1** — https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib — MIT. Full notice: `pdf-lib-LICENSE.md`.
- **@pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1** — https://github.com/Hopding/fontkit — MIT, as declared by the published package and its included README (`fontkit-README.md`). Fork by Andrew Dillon of https://github.com/foliojs/fontkit, created by Devon Govett. The distributed UMD bundle is included without code changes.
- **Lucide icons** — https://lucide.dev/ — ISC. Full notice: `lucide-LICENSE.txt`. Selected SVG icons have accessibility attributes added and a shared CSS class.
- **Open Sans / Open Sans Condensed** — Google Fonts / Steve Matteson. Apache 2.0, see `../assets/fonts/LICENSE.txt`. Font files are embedded locally, including subsets in downloaded reports.
- **Techtank logo** — supplied by the project owner. Techtank retains its trademark and brand rights.
- **DigIT Hub / EU funding artwork** — Swedish original PNG supplied by the project owner; reproduced unchanged with the statement “Medfinansieras av Europeiska unionen”. Respective organisations retain their brand rights.
